state.context: Use the provided declarations to judge a proposed hiring repair; there is no working language compiler/runtime. employee owns Employee and enforces unique user. Generated Employee.create is authorized by hr, permits user,home,locations,start,manager,role,skills as creation inputs, and prohibits delete. The exported deactivation requires hr, active employment and an end date no earlier than start. Scheduling already exposes stage with a fresh source, previous_source and previous_revision so the prior reservation can survive replacement. Applicant data and interview assessments remain owned by hire. HR review must connect an accepted applicant to a team account; auth exposes no other-user email or verification directory. onboard.start currently requires hr and independently copies the chosen current role/location template. No task/training binding exists; version one of onboarding has zero background actions. Keep the identity singular, confidentiality intact and interaction based on existing canonical workflows, including corrections. These classifications are evidence to consider, not approval or a runtime guarantee.

handoff.instructions: Among these alternatives, which honors the reviewed transition with the available canonical interfaces?

criteria.canonical_forms: Use the existing HR Employee.create control to create or reuse a unique staff-account record, followed by a hiring review action. That action captures the review evidence, validates the location and any already-linked candidate account, and invokes the exported HR-only onboard.start. It adds an HR-limited applicant projection and requires two user operations.
criteria.combined_create: Introduce a combined hiring operation collecting all Employee creation fields and verification evidence, invoking Employee.create and then onboard.start. It offers a shorter interaction but repeats a canonical input list and assumes an as-binding result for generated create whose contract is unresolved.
criteria.text_only: Leave the outcome as hired with free onboarding_reference text and keep personnel creation/checklist work disconnected. This requires fewer declarations but supplies no canonical reviewed-identity linkage.
